T: New hotel, old flames, plenty of feta.
D: As Sophie gets her mother's island hotel ready for a grand reopening, the story of how young Donna first came to Kalokairi plays out alongside.
P: Serve the keftedes when young Donna steps off the boat onto Kalokairi for the first time.
S: A night in Paris, 1979, with a nervous young Englishman
Little squares of the Paris cafe classic: ham, gruyere and mustard in buttered bread, fried, topped with bubbling cheese sauce and grilled.
Young Donna's first night on the island in 1979
Greek island tomato fritters: chopped ripe tomato, onion, mint and feta in a light batter, fried in olive oil and served with tzatziki.
M: Sophie's big night at her mother's hotel
The proper taverna moussaka: roasted eggplant layered with cinnamon-spiced lamb and tomato under a thick, golden white sauce, baked and rested so it cuts clean.
W: Baked in the hotel kitchen the morning of the party
The Greek orange cake made with torn, dried filo instead of flour, soaked in a hot orange and cinnamon syrup until rich and sticky.
K: Raised on the terrace on the hotel's opening night
Chilled sparkling wine over Greek white peach nectar with a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of peach, poured for a terrace full of guests.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Brush the eggplant with 60ml of the oil, season with half the salt and roast on trays until golden.
Brown the lamb in the rest of the oil, add the onion and garlic, then the cinnamon, oregano, tomato paste and tomatoes. Simmer until thick.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then off the heat beat in the eggs, half the cheese, the nutmeg and the rest of the salt.
Layer the eggplant and lamb in a baking dish, finish with the white sauce and the rest of the cheese.

ingredients.item: olive oil, plus extra for the tin

steps.text: Tear the filo into small pieces, spread on trays and dry in a 150C oven.
Simmer 300g of the sugar with 250ml water, the juice and peel of 1 orange and the cinnamon for the syrup, then cool.
Turn the oven to 180C. Whisk the eggs with the rest of the sugar, then whisk in half the yoghurt, the oil, the zest and juice of the other 2 oranges and the baking powder.
Fold in the filo, pour into an oiled 23 x 33cm tin and bake until golden.

s.note: Ham, gruyere and dijon in fried buttered bread, topped with nutmeg cheese sauce and grilled, cut into squares
s.how: Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, then whisk in 300ml milk until thick and add nutmeg, salt, pepper and half of 200g grated gruyere. Spread 4 slices of white bread with dijon, top with 150g sliced ham and a little gruyere and close with 4 more slices. Butter the outsides and fry until golden on both sides. Spread the tops with the cheese sauce, scatter with the rest of the gruyere and grill until bubbling and browned. Cut each into 4 squares and serve hot.

s.note: Fried fritters of ripe tomato, red onion, mint, oregano and feta, with garlic tzatziki and lemon
s.how: Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon. Chop 500g ripe tomatoes, salt them and drain in a sieve for 15 minutes. Mix with 1 finely chopped red onion, a handful of chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano, 100g crumbled feta, 120g self-raising flour and pepper to a thick batter. Fry tablespoons in 1cm of olive oil for 2 minutes a side until golden, drain and serve hot with the tzatziki and lemon wedges.

m.note: Roasted eggplant layered with lamb mince in cinnamon and tomato, under a thick golden white sauce with cheese
m.how: Brush 2 large eggplants, sliced 1cm thick, with 60ml olive oil, season and roast at 220C for 20 minutes until golden. Brown 750g lamb mince in the rest of the oil, add 1 chopped onion and 3 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tbsp tomato paste and a 400g tin crushed tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes until thick. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g flour, whisk in 700ml milk until thick, then off the heat beat in 2 eggs, half of 80g grated cheese, nutmeg and salt. Layer the eggplant and lamb in a baking dish, top with the white sauce and the rest of the cheese and bake at 180C for 50 minutes. Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

w.note: Greek orange and yoghurt cake made with torn dried filo, soaked in hot orange and cinnamon syrup, with thick yoghurt
w.how: Tear 375g filo into small pieces, spread on trays and dry in a 150C oven for 15 minutes. For the syrup, simmer 300g sugar, 250ml water, the juice and peel of 1 orange and a cinnamon stick for 5 minutes and cool. Turn the oven to 180C. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar, then whisk in 250g Greek yoghurt, 180ml olive oil, the zest and juice of 2 oranges and 2 tsp baking powder. Fold in the filo, pour into an oiled 23 x 33cm tin and bake 40 minutes until golden. Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and leave to soak at least 1 hour. Serve with yoghurt.

d.note: Chilled dry sparkling wine over peach nectar with a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of fresh peach
d.how: Chill a bottle of dry sparkling wine, 200ml peach nectar and 4 flutes. Pour 50ml nectar into each flute with a squeeze of lemon, top slowly with sparkling wine and drop in a thin slice of peach.
